title: Reading inserts with subqueries
description: You can identify how lookup expressions supply foreign-key values.

steps.description: The first INSERT names StudentID and CourseID as its target columns. You supply a SELECT expression for each value.
The second statement follows the same shape with different student-name conditions. Its course lookup still selects CS377.

steps.question: Do these INSERT statements include a SELECT that prints the resulting enrollment rows?
steps.answer: No. Their SELECT expressions supply inserted values, and the block contains no standalone result query.

steps.description: The third statement uses Brian McMullen and CS173 in its lookups. You see three statement visits in the supplied trace and no printed output.
